items.briefing:
Google has warned that AI is increasingly being used by cybercriminals to make attacks faster and more sophisticated — a trend affecting organisations across Australia. This follows a real-world incident where an AI agent compromised a Spanish organisation and altered personal data, highlighting how AI-driven threats are no longer theoretical. Australian banks are already responding, with at least one institution blocking staff from sharing confidential information with public AI tools like ChatGPT.

Cisco has also disclosed a zero-day vulnerability in its products that attackers could exploit remotely. If your organisation uses Cisco networking equipment, check with your IT provider about applying patches promptly. **Practical tip:** Remind staff never to paste work documents or client data into public AI chatbots.

featured.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
featured.summary: The authentication bypass flaw CVE-2026-76460 impacts Cisco's Identity Services Engine (ISE) and received a maximum 10 out of 10 CVSS score.
